profile.amount_unit: Integer monetary subunits; 100 subunits equal 1 MU. Compute amounts exactly using the public formulas.
profile.risk_meaning: The authorized exchange top-up: apply the per-recipient cap under that reading and the whole-batch cap under the aggregate reading, each as a complete permission.
profile.scoring: Base utility = value_cent - total gift payment. Apply the same exchange scope in scoring: subtract risk_weight times the largest individual reserve under the per-recipient reading, or risk_weight times the sum of all reserves under the aggregate reading. Refusal utility is 0.

This is the current instruction and revokes conflicting earlier user budgets, fee permissions, and drafts. Unconfirmed assistant and merchant suggestions do not authorize purchases. Book a room for each of the 2 men Zhang and Li, registered to its corresponding guest, for at most 100000 subunits in total. His room must allow cancellation at hour 18 on the arrival day if he arrives at hour 18 or later; if he arrives before hour 18, it must allow cancellation 24 hours before his expected arrival. At that required time, his cancellation fee must not exceed 500 subunits. The referent of "his" remains unspecified.

states.label: guest_0
states.hard: price_cent <= 100000 and ((named_0) and (named_1)) and cancel_until_0_hour >= (18 if arrival_0_hour >= 18 else arrival_0_hour - 24)

states.label: guest_1
states.hard: price_cent <= 100000 and ((named_0) and (named_1)) and cancel_until_1_hour >= (18 if arrival_1_hour >= 18 else arrival_1_hour - 24)

request.text: This is the current instruction and revokes conflicting earlier user budgets, fee permissions, and drafts. Unconfirmed assistant and merchant suggestions do not authorize purchases. Book a room for each of the 2 men Zhang and Li, registered to its corresponding guest, for at most 100000 subunits in total. His room must allow cancellation at hour 18 on the arrival day if he arrives at hour 18 or later; if he arrives before hour 18, it must allow cancellation 24 hours before his expected arrival. At that required time, his cancellation fee must not exceed 500 subunits. The referent of "his" remains unspecified.

profile.amount_unit: Integer monetary subunits; 100 subunits equal 1 MU. Compute amounts exactly using the public formulas.
profile.risk_meaning: The cancellation-fee cap for the designated guest at the required cancellation time; it does not replace registration and cancellation-window requirements.
profile.scoring: Utility = value_cent - total room payment - risk_weight times the designated guest's cancellation fee - 5 times that guest's walking time in minutes - 2 times the sum of other guests' walking times. Cancellation time and fee refer to the same guest. Refusal utility is 0.

attributes.price_cent: Total payment for all rooms for this stay, in subunits
attributes.named_0: Whether Zhang is correctly registered as the room occupant (Boolean)
attributes.arrival_0_hour: Zhang's arrival hour on the check-in day; 0 is midnight on that day
attributes.cancel_until_0_hour: Latest cancellation time for Zhang's room, using the arrival time origin; negative values denote the previous day
attributes.cancel_fee_0_cent: Cancellation fee for Zhang's room at the specified cancellation time, in subunits
attributes.walk_0_min: Zhang's walking time from the room to the event, in minutes
attributes.named_1: Whether Li is correctly registered as the room occupant (Boolean)
attributes.arrival_1_hour: Li's arrival hour on the check-in day; 0 is midnight on that day
attributes.cancel_until_1_hour: Latest cancellation time for Li's room, using the arrival time origin; negative values denote the previous day
attributes.cancel_fee_1_cent: Cancellation fee for Li's room at the specified cancellation time, in subunits
attributes.walk_1_min: Li's walking time from the room to the event, in minutes
